verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents REST and GraphQL APIs for managing orders programmatically and automating store processes. It also documents OAuth API accounts and webhooks, including GCP Pub/Sub delivery. Together these support agent-driven order status handling and event-driven workflows without the admin, though the evidence never covers the specific post-purchase steps. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of fulfillment/shipment APIs, any returns/refunds API, order-status webhook event specifics, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end post-purchase flow.
